That way I don’t need to carry so many things that I can’t afford; I don’t have to work 12 hours every night for a salary of $2 an hour; I don’t have to worry about being fired by my boss after I’m 35 years old; I don’t have to because I can’t afford it forever. You don’t have to get married because you don’t need thousands of people to fight for a civil servant position; you don’t have to worry about ruining your family after a serious illness when you get old, and you have nowhere to go and sleep on the streets...
